system.description: Astrological Charm (Greater Art). The Sidereal makes the Greater Sign of the Mask. Her anima banner flares to full display, shifting through the colors of all five castes in a rainbow wave before brightening to a glorious white halo, sparkling with prismatic highlights. While this Charm is in effect, the Sidereal is considered a member of all five castes and is under the active effects of all five anima powers, with the additional benefit that their effects are extended to all allies within one mile. If she meets the proper prerequisites, she may even choose to invoke any of the five Greater Signs of the Maidens at standard cost. Unlike the rest of the Greater Arts, this Charm does not penalize Craft (Fate) rolls. The pattern spiders look upon the display and object because they do not understand it.
